selection_rule: source feasibility and evidence semantics only; no MCOP, T2D, CRC, candidate rank, association result, or pathway result inspected
why_no_primary_epidemiology_source: No candidate-independent Step 10A audit established the joint availability of a harmonizable exposure, T2D outcome, core covariates, design weights, and usable individual-level access. Conditional sources remain queued.

entity_resolution_rules.chemical: Prefer stable structure/CAS/PubChem/DTXSID/ChEMBL/BindingDB crosswalks; retain unresolved and ambiguous records explicitly.
entity_resolution_rules.gene: Resolve to stable human GeneID/Ensembl/UniProt with a versioned mapping table; do not merge source-specific evidence before resolution.
entity_resolution_rules.disease: Use source-native ontology identifiers and a frozen T2D concept mapping; retain direct versus descendant trait matches separately.
entity_resolution_rules.participant: Require source-native participant ID, exposure, outcome, core covariates, and design variables in the same approved extract.

success_criteria.environmental: At least two primary replacement sources yield versioned, human-compatible, entity-resolved records on the same chemical unit; report coverage, overlap, rank/edge concordance, and missingness.
success_criteria.disease: Both primary disease replacements yield a predeclared T2D gene set with versioned ontology mapping and source-specific evidence fields.
success_criteria.epidemiology: A source is promoted from conditional only after exposure, T2D outcome, core covariates, design variables, access, and chemical harmonization are verified without inspecting association results.
success_criteria.overall: No candidate is promoted or demoted from the frozen set solely because a replacement source agrees or disagrees with an observed association.
